_meta.display_name: colibri (large MoE, experts streamed from disk)
_meta.description: colibri's OpenAI-compatible coli serve - DeepSeek V4.1 Flash, GLM-5.x, Kimi K3 and other models llama.cpp does not run. Directly (port 8000), or through llama_direct's /engines/<name> proxy, which starts it on demand and frees the node's memory from llama-server first.

port.label: Port
port.hint: 8790 = llama_direct (with Base Path /engines/<name>); 8000 = coli serve directly (Base Path blank)

base_path.label: Base Path
base_path.hint: /engines/<engine name in llama_direct's engines.json>, or blank when talking to coli serve directly

api_key.label: API Key
api_key.hint: coli serve's COLI_API_KEY, sent as Authorization: Bearer

timeout_s.label: Request Timeout (s)
timeout_s.hint: Disk-streaming prefill of a long prompt can take many minutes before the first token

_think_doc: Thinking off sends reasoning_effort none; on sends high; a level (low, medium, high, max) passes through. colibri maps levels onto the model's own vocabulary (DeepSeek V4: low / high / max).

num_predict.hint: sent as max_tokens - a ceiling; colibri clamps it to what the context holds
